description: Find routes near a point, within a bounding box, by operator, by Onestop ID, or by mode. Returns each route's Onestop ID, short and long name, mode (bus, rail, ferry, subway, tram, …), brand color, and the operating agency's Onestop ID. These are scheduled (GTFS static) route definitions, not live vehicle positions. Geocode place names to coordinates with openstreetmap_geocode before passing lat/lon. Provide at least one of: lat+lon, bbox, operator_onestop_id, onestop_id, or search.

after.description: Pagination cursor from a previous response (enrichment.cursor).

bbox.description: Bounding box "minLon,minLat,maxLon,maxLat". Alternative to lat/lon/radius. Cannot be combined with lat/lon.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center (WGS84). Requires lon. Geocode place names with openstreetmap_geocode first — Transitland does not accept place names.

limit.description: Maximum routes to return. Values above 100 apply the 100-result page cap with a notice. Page further with the after cursor.

lon.description: Longitude of the search center (WGS84). Requires lat.

onestop_id.description: Fetch one route directly by its Onestop ID (e.g. "r-9q9p-800") or internal integer ID.

operator_onestop_id.description: Restrict to routes operated by this operator (Onestop ID, e.g. "o-9q9-bart"). Combine with search to find a specific line within an operator.

radius.description: Search radius in meters around lat/lon (max 50,000). Routes are matched when they pass within the radius.

route_type.description: GTFS route_type filter: 0=tram/streetcar, 1=subway/metro, 2=rail, 3=bus, 4=ferry, 5=cable tram, 6=aerial lift, 7=funicular, 11=trolleybus, 12=monorail. Omit for all modes.

search.description: Full-text search over route short and long names (e.g. "Red Line", "44"). Pair with operator_onestop_id or geography to disambiguate.

name: transitland_find_routes

cursor.description: Pass as `after` to fetch the next page. Present only when more results exist.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `no_filter`: No coordinates, bbox, operator, onestop_id, or search provided (server-enforced guard — the API accepts unfiltered requests but returns a global dump). `incomplete_point`: lat without lon or lon without lat. `rate_limited`: Transitland returned HTTP 429. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

color.description: Brand color as a hex string without "#" (e.g. "00AEEF"). Null when unspecified.

description.description: Route description (e.g. "via Columbus / 7 Av"). Often null.

feedOnestopId.description: Onestop ID of the feed this route came from. Pass to transitland_find_feeds for the source data and license.

longName.description: Full route name (e.g. "Harlem - 14th Street"). Null when omitted.

mode.description: Human-readable basic or recognized extended GTFS mode, including coach and water transport. Extended urban rail 400–404 uses the coarse label subway. "unknown" when route_type is missing; "type N" for other present codes.

operator.description: The agency that runs this route.

onestopId.description: Operating agency Onestop ID (e.g. "o-dr5r-nyct"). Use with transitland_get_operator.

routeType.description: GTFS route_type integer. Null when omitted upstream.

shortName.description: Route short name/number as shown to riders (e.g. "44", "Red"). Null when the feed omits it.

truncated.description: True when results were capped at the limit.

title: transitland-mcp-server: find routes
